text_en: Finally, brothers and sisters, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus that, as you learned from us how you ought to live and to please God (as, in fact, you are doing), you should do so more and more.
text_cn: 此外，弟兄们，我们在主耶稣内还请求和劝勉你们：你们既由我们学会了应怎样行事，为中悦天主，你们就该怎样行事，还要更向前迈进。

text_en: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
text_cn: 你们原来知道：我们因主耶稣给了你们什么诫命。

text_en: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from fornication;
text_cn: 天主的旨意就是要你们成圣，要你们戒绝邪淫，

text_en: that each one of you know how to control your own body in holiness and honor,
text_cn: 要你们每一个人明了，应以圣洁和敬意持守自己的肉体，

text_en: not with lustful passion, like the Gentiles who do not know God;
text_cn: 不要放纵邪淫之情，像那些不认识天主的外邦人一样；

text_en: that no one wrong or exploit a brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, just as we have already told you beforehand and solemnly warned you.
text_cn: 在这样的事上，不要侵犯损害自己的弟兄，因为主对这一切是要报复的，就如我们先前已说过，已证明过的，

text_en: For God did not call us to impurity but in holiness.
text_cn: 因为天主召叫我们不是为不洁，而是为成圣。

text_en: Therefore whoever rejects this rejects not human authority but God, who also gives his Holy Spirit to you.
text_cn: 所以凡轻视这诫命的，不是轻视人，而是轻视那将自己的圣神赋于你们身上的天主。

text_en: Now concerning love of the brothers and sisters, you do not need to have anyone write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another;
text_cn: 关于弟兄的友爱，不需要给你们写什么，因为你们自己由天主受了彼此相爱的教训。

text_en: and indeed you do love all the brothers and sisters throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, beloved, to do so more and more,
text_cn: 你们对全马其顿的众弟兄原已实行了这事；不过，弟兄们，我们劝你们更向前迈进。

text_en: to aspire to live quietly, to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, as we directed you,
text_cn: 你们要以过安定的生活，专务己业，亲手劳作为光荣，就如我们所吩咐过你们的，

text_en: so that you may behave properly toward outsiders and be dependent on no one.
text_cn: 好叫你们在外人前来往时有光釆，不仰仗任何人。

text_en: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who have died, so that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope.
text_cn: 弟兄们，关于亡者，我们不愿意你们不知道，以免你们忧伤，像其他没有望德的人一样。

text_en: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so, through Jesus, God will bring with him those who have died.
text_cn: 因为我们若是信耶稣死了，也复活了，同样也必信天主要领那些死于耶稣内的人同他一起来。

text_en: For this we declare to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will by no means precede those who have died.
text_cn: 我们照主的话告诉你们这件事：我们这些活着存留到主来临时的人，决不会在已死的人以前。

text_en: For the Lord himself, with a cry of command, with the archangel’s call and with the sound of God’s trumpet, will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
text_cn: 因为在发命时，在总领天使呐喊和天主的号声响时，主要亲自由天降来，那些死于基督内的人先要复活，

text_en: Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up in the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the air; and so we will be with the Lord forever.
text_cn: 然后我们这些活着还存留的人，同时与他们一起要被提到云彩上，到空中迎接主：这样，我们就时常同主在一起。

text_en: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
text_cn: 为此，你们要常用这些话彼此安慰。
